description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Regulation made to amend the Regulation 31 of the Wages Boards Regulations 1971
categorisation: The gazette content is a regulation made by the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, amending the Wages Boards Regulations. It involves the modification of existing legal regulations (specifically, changing monetary amounts in the Wages Boards Ordinance), which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and amendments to existing legislation.
